<div align="center">
  <h1>
    💎💥🪲📋
    <br>
    Emoji Commits
  </h1>

  A&nbsp;guide to&nbsp;writing great commit messages with emojis!
</div>

<table align="center">
  <tr>
    <td>💎</td>
    <td>Add, extend</td>
    <td>Introduce new functionality or enhance existing features.</td>
  </tr>
  <tr>
    <td>💥</td>
    <td>Remove, deprecate</td>
    <td>Introduce breaking changes to existing features.</td>
  </tr>
  <tr>
    <td>🧩</td>
    <td>Refactor, rename</td>
    <td>Restructure for clarity, readability, and maintainability.</td>
  </tr>
  <tr>
    <td>🚀</td>
    <td>Optimize</td>
    <td>Improve performance, memory efficiency, or resource usage.</td>
  </tr>
  <tr>
    <td>🎨</td>
    <td>Style, format</td>
    <td>Adjust whitespace, indentations, or apply linter rules.</td>
  </tr>
  <tr>
    <td>📋</td>
    <td>Document</td>
    <td>Add or update comments, documentation files, or guides.</td>
  </tr>
  <tr>
    <td>🪲</td>
    <td>Fix</td>
    <td>Resolve issues, bugs, errors, or handle edge cases.</td>
  </tr>
  <tr>
    <td>🔒</td>
    <td>Patch</td>
    <td>Mitigate security vulnerabilities and harden weaknesses.</td>
  </tr>
  <tr>
    <td>🧪</td>
    <td>Test</td>
    <td>Add or update unit or integration test coverage.</td>
  </tr>
  <tr>
    <td>🧰</td>
    <td>Configure</td>
    <td>Set up or modify build tools, CI pipelines, or project environments.</td>
  </tr>
  <tr>
    <td>📦</td>
    <td>Maintain</td>
    <td>Update dependencies, clean up, or do other internal chores.</td>
  </tr>
  <tr>
    <td>🎉</td>
    <td>Release</td>
    <td>Publish new releases, versions, tags, or changelog updates.</td>
  </tr>
  <tr>
    <td>🤝</td>
    <td>Merge</td>
    <td>Handle code merges or resolve conflicts.</td>
  </tr>
  <tr>
    <td>✂️</td>
    <td>Revert</td>
    <td>Roll back changes, restore previous state.</td>
  </tr>
  <tr>
    <td>🚧</td>
    <td>Snapshot</td>
    <td>Mark as incomplete work in progress.</td>
  </tr>
</table>
